---
title: "Candidate monitoring locations and design constraints"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

Candidate locations must be supplied explicitly. Allowed and exclusion areas,
spacing, cost, target areas, and any user scores remain visible.
`ps_candidate_network()` supports coverage, support-gap, model-conditional
kriging-variance reduction, or preserved user scores. Sequential greedy
selection updates after each choice; it is not globally optimal and does not
establish access, ownership, constructability, or drillability.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
design <- ps_candidate_network(existing, candidates, "support_gap",
                               n_select=3, target=weak_support,
                               exclusion_area=exclusions)
```
